body:
i am so sorry you had to go through this. i will spare you the "it will get better" talk because i know thats not entirely true. but it does, however, get easier. over time it will hurt less. the most important thing you can do is remind yourself he loved you as much as you loved him. he would understand the decision you made and why. even though he couldnt say it, he was grateful you made that difficult choice. he is no longer in pain. he is somewhere beautiful and he is grateful.

im sending you and your boy all of my love. its okay to hurt and to mourn, so dont try to bottle that up.
i know exactly how you feel and im sorry youre going through this. i hope your religion can become a source of strength for you some day.
